title: नवनवतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Strengthened by Vishnu and the sages, Indra hurls the thunderbolt and kills Vritra, who had covered heaven and earth. The surviving Kalakeya demons flee into the ocean and plot to destroy the world.
summary.kn: ವಿಷ್ಣು ಮತ್ತು ಋಷಿಗಳಿಂದ ಬಲಪಡೆದ ಇಂದ್ರನು ವಜ್ರಾಯುಧ ಪ್ರಯೋಗಿಸಿ ಭೂಮ್ಯಾಕಾಶಗಳನ್ನು ಆವರಿಸಿದ್ದ ವೃತ್ರನನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಉಳಿದ ಕಾಲಕೇಯರು ಸಮುದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡಗಿ ಲೋಕನಾಶಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಚು ಹೂಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: विष्णु और ऋषियों से बल पाकर इन्द्र वज्र चलाते हैं और आकाश-पृथ्वी को ढकने वाले वृत्र को मार डालते हैं। बचे हुए कालकेय दैत्य समुद्र में भागकर संसार के विनाश का षड्यन्त्र रचते हैं।
summary.te: విష్ణువు, ఋషుల వల్ల బలం పొందిన ఇంద్రుడు వజ్రాయుధం ప్రయోగించి భూమ్యాకాశాలను కప్పివేసిన వృత్రుని సంహరిస్తాడు. మిగిలిన కాలకేయులు సముద్రంలో దాక్కొని లోకనాశనానికి కుట్ర పన్నుతారు.
summary.ta: விஷ்ணுவாலும் முனிவர்களாலும் வலிமை பெற்ற இந்திரன் வஜ்ராயுதத்தை எறிந்து, வானையும் பூமியையும் மூடியிருந்த வ்ருத்ரனைக் கொல்கிறான். எஞ்சிய காலகேய அசுரர்கள் கடலுக்குள் ஒளிந்து உலகை அழிக்கச் சூழ்ச்சி செய்கிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: വിഷ്ണുവിനാലും മുനിമാരാലും ശക്തനായ ഇന്ദ്രൻ വജ്രം എറിഞ്ഞ് വൃത്രനെ വധിക്കുന്നു; ആകാശവും ഭൂമിയും മൂടിയിരുന്നവനാണ് വൃത്രൻ. രക്ഷപ്പെട്ട കാലകേയ അസുരന്മാർ സമുദ്രത്തിൽ ഒളിക്കുകയും ലോകനാശത്തിന് ഗൂഢാലോചന നടത്തുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.99; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: लोमश उवाच

meaning.en: Lomasha said:

verses.text:
ततः स वज्री बलिभिर्दैवतैरभिरक्षितः ।
आससाद ततो वृत्रं स्थितमावृत्य रोदसी ॥

meaning.en: Then the wielder of the thunderbolt, guarded by mighty gods, came upon Vritra, who stood filling heaven and earth.

verses.text:
कालकेयैर्महाकायैः समन्तादभिरक्षितम् ।
समुद्यतप्रहरणैः सशृङ्गैरिव पर्वतैः ॥

meaning.en: He was guarded on every side by the huge Kaleyas with weapons raised, like mountains with peaks.

verses.text:
ततो युद्धं समभवद्देवानां सह दानवैः ।
मुहूर्तं भरतश्रेष्ठ लोकत्रासकरं महत् ॥

meaning.en: Then a battle took place between the gods and the Danavas, best of Bharatas, a great one that terrified the worlds, for a short time.

verses.text:
उद्यतप्रतिपिष्टानां खड्गानां वीरबाहुभिः ।
आसीत्सुतुमुलः शब्दः शरीरेष्वभिपात्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: There was a tremendous din of swords raised and struck by heroes' arms, and of blows falling on bodies.

verses.text:
शिरोभिः प्रपतद्भिश्च अन्तरिक्षान्महीतलम् ।
तालैरिव महीपाल वृन्ताद्भ्रष्टैरदृश्यत ॥

meaning.en: Heads fell from the sky to the ground, king, like palm fruits fallen from their stalks.

verses.text:
ते हेमकवचा भूत्वा कालेयाः परिघायुधाः ।
त्रिदशानभ्यवर्तन्त दावदग्धा इवाद्रयः ॥

meaning.en: The Kaleyas put on golden armour, took up clubs, and charged the gods like mountains blazing in a forest fire.

verses.text:
तेषां वेगवतां वेगं सहितानां प्रधावताम् ।
न शेकुस्त्रिदशाः सोढुं ते भग्नाः प्राद्रवन्भयात् ॥

meaning.en: The gods could not bear the rush of those swift, charging, massed foes, and broke and fled in fear.

verses.text:
तान्दृष्ट्वा द्रवतो भीतान्सहस्राक्षः पुरंदरः ।
वृत्रे विवर्धमाने च कश्मलं महदाविशत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing them flee in fear, a great faintness came over thousand-eyed Indra as Vritra swelled in strength.

verses.text:
तं शक्रं कश्मलाविष्टं दृष्ट्वा विष्णुः सनातनः ।
स्वतेजो व्यदधाच्छक्रे बलमस्य विवर्धयन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Indra overcome by faintness, eternal Vishnu put his own energy into him, increasing his strength.

verses.text:
विष्णुनाप्यायितं शक्रं दृष्ट्वा देवगणास्ततः ।
स्वं स्वं तेजः समादध्युस्तथा ब्रह्मर्षयोऽमलाः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Indra strengthened by Vishnu, the hosts of gods, and the pure Brahmin sages, each gave him their energy.

verses.text:
स समाप्यायितः शक्रो विष्णुना दैवतैः सह ।
ऋषिभिश्च महाभागैर्बलवान्समपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: So refreshed by Vishnu, by the gods and by the fortunate sages, Indra became mighty.

verses.text:
ज्ञात्वा बलस्थं त्रिदशाधिपं तु
ननाद वृत्रो महतो निनादान् ।
तस्य प्रणादेन धरा दिशश्च
खं द्यौर्नगाश्चापि चचाल सर्वम् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing the lord of the gods established in strength, Vritra roared great roars. By his bellowing the earth, the quarters, the sky, heaven and the mountains all shook.

verses.text:
ततो महेन्द्रः परमाभितप्तः
श्रुत्वा रवं घोररूपं महान्तम् ।
भये निमग्नस्त्वरितं मुमोच
वज्रं महत्तस्य वधाय राजन् ॥

meaning.en: Then Mahendra, greatly distressed at hearing that fearful, huge roar, sunk in fear, quickly hurled the great thunderbolt to kill him, king.

verses.text:
स शक्रवज्राभिहतः पपात
महासुरः काञ्चनमाल्यधारी ।
यथा महाञ्शैलवरः पुरस्ता-
त्स मन्दरो विष्णुकरात्प्रमुक्तः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by Indra's thunderbolt, the great asura wearing golden garlands fell like the great mountain Mandara hurled from Vishnu's hand.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्हते दैत्यवरे भयार्तः
शक्रः प्रदुद्राव सरः प्रवेष्टुम् ।
वज्रं न मेने स्वकरात्प्रमुक्तं
वृत्रं हतं चापि भयान्न मेने ॥

meaning.en: When that best of Daityas was slain, Indra, tormented by fear, ran to enter a lake; he did not believe the thunderbolt had left his hand, nor, in his fear, that Vritra was dead.

verses.text:
सर्वे च देवा मुदिताः प्रहृष्टा
महर्षयश्चेन्द्रमभिष्टुवन्तः ।
सर्वांश्च दैत्यांस्त्वरिताः समेत्य
जघ्नुः सुरा वृत्रवधाभितप्तान् ॥

meaning.en: All the gods rejoiced and exulted, and the great sages praised Indra, and the gods quickly came together and struck down all the Daityas, who were burning with grief at Vritra's death.

verses.text:
ते वध्यमानास्त्रिदशैस्तदानीं
समुद्रमेवाविविशुर्भयार्ताः ।
प्रविश्य चैवोदधिमप्रमेयं
झषाकुलं रत्नसमाकुलं च ॥

meaning.en: Struck by the gods, they fled in fear into the sea, entering the immeasurable ocean full of fish and crowded with jewels.

verses.text:
तदा स्म मन्त्रं सहिताः प्रचक्रु-
स्त्रैलोक्यनाशार्थमभिस्मयन्तः ।
तत्र स्म केचिन्मतिनिश्चयज्ञा-
स्तांस्तानुपायाननुवर्णयन्ति ॥

meaning.en: There, together, smiling, they made a plan to destroy the three worlds, and some who knew the way of deciding described this and that method.

verses.text:
तेषां तु तत्र क्रमकालयोगा-
द्घोरा मतिश्चिन्तयतां बभूव ।
ये सन्ति विद्यातपसोपपन्ना-
स्तेषां विनाशः प्रथमं तु कार्यः ॥

meaning.en: Their dreadful thinking, as time and order allowed, settled on this: "Those who are endowed with learning and austerity must be destroyed first.

verses.text:
लोका हि सर्वे तपसा ध्रियन्ते
तस्मात्त्वरध्वं तपसः क्षयाय ।
ये सन्ति केचिद्धि वसुंधरायां
तपस्विनो धर्मविदश्च तज्ज्ञाः ।
तेषां वधः क्रियतां क्षिप्रमेव
तेषु प्रनष्टेषु जगत्प्रनष्टम् ॥

meaning.en: "For all the worlds are upheld by austerity, so hurry to end austerity. Whatever ascetics and knowers of dharma there are on earth, let them be killed quickly; when they are destroyed, the world is destroyed."

verses.text:
एवं हि सर्वे गतबुद्धिभावा
जगद्विनाशे परमप्रहृष्टाः ।
दुर्गं समाश्रित्य महोर्मिमन्तं
रत्नाकरं वरुणस्यालयं स्म ॥

meaning.en: Thus, minds made up and greatly delighted at the world's ruin, they took shelter in the sea, the mine of jewels, the abode of Varuna with its great waves, as a stronghold.
